title: AND2ES — everything set in 11px black pills
note: All interface text is Helvetica Neue 500, 11px, letter-spacing 0.132px, white on solid #000 rectangles with only 3px of side padding and about 7px top and bottom (line-height 0, so the padding sets the height). The nav pills (Work, Index, Information) have a fixed width of about 100px, so they read as tabs. The current page's pill turns #e6e6e6 with black text. A live clock pill ("15:01:15 (PST) Friday October 2 2026") sits next to the logo pill. Meta pills pair a value with a 7px grey label set right after it ("Travis Scott Client", "Design Music Categories"), and filter pills carry superscript counts ("Design⁽⁹⁾"). Worth reusing: one tiny size for everything, with hierarchy coming only from the black or grey fill.
